blends.desc:
# The Silver Exchange

This process allows for the transmutation of Bronze to Silver Bullion.
 
2 Bronze Bullion = 1 Silver Bullion 

Please note: *By participating in the bullion exchange, you agree to the abatement of the overall value of your return.*
